en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Yusuf, from Abdul Salam, from Hisham Bin Ahmar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:
‘The price of real estate is annihilated unless if it is made to be in a real estate similar to it’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Yusuf from ‘Abd al-Salam from Hisham ibn Ahmar who has said the following: “Abu Ibrahim, Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the price (money) received in exchange for real estate is a loss unless another piece of real estate is purchased therewith.”
